description: React component for managing starter prompts in a chat flow, including UI for adding/removing prompts, saving to API, and handling state.

methods.name: addInputField
methods.description: Adds a new prompt input field to the list.

methods.name: removeInputFields
methods.description: Removes a prompt input field at specified index.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change in prompt input fields.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current prompts to the chat flow via API and updates state.
